owner_calls.question: Season 1 episodes 4 and 6 are officially "Motendo / Lifedeath – Part 1" and "Lifedeath – Part 2" (en dash), but the app has "Lifedeath, Part 1/2". Do you want the official en-dash form or the app's own ", Part N" style? The app uses that style for multi-part episodes everywhere (Wikipedia gives "Tolerance Is Extinction" as one title split into parts).
options: Keep the app style ", Part N"
Use the official "Motendo / Lifedeath – Part 1" and "Lifedeath – Part 2"
owner_calls.evidence: X-Men '97 season 1 episode table: Title_2 = Lifedeath – Part 1; Title = Lifedeath – Part 2 (the Disney+ episode citation uses the same title).
